adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is assigned `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null,` around the `evt` construction). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which is skipped when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, silently dropping the member calendars accumulated in `teamDestinationCalendars` (built from `users.slice(1)` when members have `user.destinationCalendar`). Downstream, `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` only iterates destinations when `event.destinationCalendar && event.destinationCalendar.length > 0`; if it's null, it falls back to the default behavior (creating events via credentials without the per-member `externalId`), matching the finding's described no-op and fallback behavior.
